title: Temporary ban on sale of disposable BBQs over wildfire risk
description: Single-use grills pose a "significant risk to the public" in current drought and heatwave conditions, the government warns.

title: Chris Mason: Where does this unorthodox by-election victory leave Nigel Farage?
description: As expected, the Reform UK leader easily won the Clacton by-election but was nowhere to be seen after the result.

title: Britain's Finlay Tarling dies in Volta a Portugal accident
description: British cyclist Finlay Tarling dies at the age of 19 in a serious accident during the eighth stage of the Volta a Portugal.
